slices.title: Plan approve-then-execute
slices.summary: Plan approval starts a new Do run on the same thread: the gateway binds the thread's durable grant to the new run server-side (BindGrantToRun on WS04's ThreadAutonomy, plan id must match, single-use CAS, no client-supplied rung) and the SPA sends one execute turn carrying approved_plan_id, behind MODEL_GATEWAY_PLAN_EXECUTE_ON_APPROVE (default off, where next_message keeps today's behaviour). Authority narrows, never widens, for a run in flight.
slices.remaining: S2b is not built: the durable approve-then-execute path (BindGrantToRun and ThreadAutonomy on the WS04-S4 durable thread grant, MODEL_GATEWAY_DURABLE_PLAN_GRANT) that replaces the S2a in-memory PlanModeStore grant. S2a, the interim run-the-approved-plan path, is built and live-proven.

decisions_defaults.DEC-04 (WS14-D1; needed to merge S2): (DEC-04 (WS14-D1; needed to merge S2)) (a): a plan run is read-only and WS03's rule is that authority narrows, never widens; (a) reuses the whole send path. SPA sends an explicit execute turn with `approved_plan_id`: new Do run, same thread, durable grant + plan block. (b) later

slices.title: Office previewer in the artifact panel
slices.summary: Attach an optional transient PDF preview (page count, substitution flag, thumbnails) to the attachment event and render it in a new office-pdf renderer as a sandboxed PDF frame with a page strip and a font-substitution notice, falling back to the file card. The download still returns the byte-identical sandbox output.

slices.title: Do browser act with risk gate and site consent
slices.summary: Adds browser.act{action} behind a risk classifier over wire actions: read-level grants refuse act before any call, risky acts pause for approval with a typed cause, and a site that needs consent raises browser_site_consent clamped to the grant cap. act must not be enabled until the Quarry read_only contract test (K3-6) proves mutating actions are refused on read grants.
slices.flag: same as S5a (EXECUTION_DO_BROWSER_ENABLED with BROWSER_BROKER_SITE_POLICY=enforce); browser.act stays off until the Quarry read_only contract test passes (K3-6)
risk: cross-branch: the Quarry-side grant issuance endpoint and Quarry-to-broker identity are built on local branch quarryv2, not on model-plane; build against the contract with a stub and leave the live proof to the lead after quarryv2 merges

decisions_defaults.DEC-19: (d) layered: Control org-core is policy of record, broker enforces at mint from the verified principal, Quarry stays final enforcer. One grant per (run, level), fence = start host + at most 8 hosts; open web minus block list default; private/loopback never gra
decisions_defaults.DEC-20: Server-bound: model sees `browser.open{url}`, `.observe{}`, `.act{action}`, `.close{}`. New cause `browser_site_consent`. Grant minted under the user's delegated BrowserBroker bearer, never from request JSON. Grant store decided by QRY; WS21 works on in-memory
